description: Prospect site built on spec for Garage Mécanique E.L. (17565, rue de la Paix, Mirabel QC). Source: the garage's public 411garage.com listing (11 services, hours Mon–Fri 9–18, phone 450-820-8213, cash & Visa, serves Mirabel + Blainville) and its logo (remade with gpt-image-2.5 edit).

customConfig.businessAddress: 17565, rue de la Paix, Mirabel (Québec) J7J 1M3

designManifest.summary: The garage's own logo is a neon sign on carbon, so every brand moment is neon line art on carbon; every functional flow (booking, account, admin records) is a carbon-copy work order on paper, filled in ballpoint blue, with rubber-stamp statuses.
designManifest.signatureMove: A live neon OUVERT / FERMÉ sign in the header computed from the real hours (flickers on once when open).
designManifest.typography: Barlow Condensed 600–800 display (automotive signage), Barlow 400–700 text.
